constraints.description: The session that found it is permitted to edit .claude/scripts/pre-push and .claude/tests/pre-push-set.test.sh

options.label: Fix it in this run

options.label: Record it and route it to its owner

criteria.label: Cost to the next session or agent
criteria.description: Every push in this repository runs the hook; a worker inherits the unenforced budget by default, without going looking

criteria.label: Residual silence
criteria.description: The hook prints elapsed_ms beside the budget and passes; three observed runs at 42028ms, 39690ms and 52959ms against 30000ms failed nobody

criteria.label: Contamination of later work
criteria.description: The declared per-gate cost table is verified for its own arithmetic while the observed total runs 32-76 percent over it, so every later gate added to the set is sized against a number nobody re-measures

criteria.label: Cost to the run in hand
criteria.description: A comparison at the point both numbers are already computed, plus one matrix case driving a stub gate past the budget

criteria.label: Scope integrity
criteria.description: The finding surfaced while capturing pre-push measurements, not while working on the hook

criteria.label: Reversibility of the option
criteria.description: The repair reports rather than fails, so a wrong threshold costs a printed line and not a blocked push
